meaning: nettles, weeds, kind of weed (perhaps chickpea)

elsewhere.note: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles .
Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.
Therefore as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles…
